travel.landingWindow: Be on the ground by Thursday afternoon. The draft is that night and you want to be in the room for it.
travel.note: PSP is the closest airport by a long way, but the fares are often worse than flying into LA or Orange County and driving out. Plenty of the field will do exactly that.

airports.name: Palm Springs International
airports.note: Closest by far. Small, easy, and you are at the house before the kettle boils.

airports.name: Los Angeles International
airports.note: The most flights and usually the cheapest way in from overseas. Hire a car.

airports.name: John Wayne · Orange County
airports.note: Smaller and far less painful than LAX when the fare stacks up.
